entities.summary: Monumenta Serica: Journal of Oriental Studies is an international academic journal of sinology. It was published by Monumenta Serica Institute in Sankt Augustin, and now by Routledge. The editor-in-chief was until 2012 Roman Malek and is now Zbigniew Wesołowski.
